title: Maximum Positive or Negative Count
description: Given a non-decreasing sorted integer array `nums`, count its strictly negative elements and its strictly positive elements. Ignore zeros and return the larger of those two counts. Input: sorted `nums`. Output: the maximum count.
constraints: nums is sorted in non-decreasing order
hints: Keep a running total or frequency count rather than recomputing over all prefixes.
Test repeated values, zeros, and minimum-size inputs.
